The trilogy consisting of I Choose You!, The Power of Us, and Secrets of the Jungle, along with the special tie-in episode The Distant Blue Sky, features an alternate version of the characters and world from , establishing its own separate canon. As part of the Pokémon movies and animated series specials, it is not considered directly part of Pokémon the Series, though it is closely related.

The trilogy consisting of I Choose You!, The Power of Us, and Secrets of the Jungle, along with the special tie-in episode The Distant Blue Sky, features an alternate version of the characters and world from , establishing its own separate canon. As part of the Pokémon movies and animated series specials, it is not considered directly part of Pokémon the Series, though it is closely related.

During the Pokémon Panel at San Diego Comic-Con in 2023, the trilogy is described as "the cinematic universe that Pokémon started with Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!." 

==Plot==
As with , the movie trilogy follows Ash as the central character. His story begins very similar to the of the animated series, oversleeping on his tenth birthday and ending up with a stubborn Pikachu as his that goes on to be his best friend. After catching some of the same as his animated series counterpart, Ash's story takes a different path leading him to meet a variety of different people and Pokémon on his own adventures.
